lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 삼촌 인상착의 좀 알려 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, can you tell me what your uncle looks like?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, samchon insangchagui jom allyeo jullaeyo?
lines.en: Sure, I'll describe my uncle in detail.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks. What about his height and build?
lines.learner: 키가 크고 체형은 좀 마른 편이에요.
lines.en: He's tall and has a rather slim build.
lines.roman: Kiga keugo chehyeongeun jom mareun pyeonieyo.

lines.beaver_en: And his face? Does he have a beard?
lines.en: Yes, he has a short beard around his mouth.
He's bald. So he looks older than his age.

lines.beaver_en: Has he changed a lot with age?
lines.learner: 나이가 듦에 따라 주름이 많이 늘었어요.
lines.en: As he aged, he got a lot more wrinkles.
lines.roman: Naiga deulme ttara jureumi mani neureosseoyo.

lines.en: He has deep wrinkles on his forehead and thick eyebrows.
He seems blunt at first, but looks gentle when he smiles.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, how cute. What's he wearing today?
lines.learner: 회색 양복이요. 근데 면도기를 두고 오셨대요.
lines.en: A gray suit. But he says he left his razor behind.
lines.roman: Hoesaek yangbogiyo. Geunde myeondogireul dugo osyeotdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then his beard must be a bit long?
lines.en: Yeah, his beard will probably be scruffy.

lines.beaver_en: Got it. I'll look for him at the airport.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll call my uncle ahead of time.
